<description>
found we can optimize `CastToBool` used by IFDUP, VERIFY while reviewing #36721.

Currently the loop checks one byte at a time, instead we can process one word of 8 bytes at a time.

For the worst case scenario of one-tx-block with a script `<520-byte stack element> [IFDUP VERIFY] repeated`, with the element being 519 zero bytes + 0x01:

the benchamrk shows 3.1x speedup (from ~922ms to ~295ms)

Master at  https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/commit/a527a0077a0fcae913188410214efe98021c0cca:
